err.objective_gps_off: Objective GPS is switched off on this server. Follow the objective text instead.
err.objective_gps_none: There is no objective on your map right now, so there is nothing to show.
err.objective_gps_start: Drive to the mission start first: your GPS shows the way there.
err.objective_gps_silence: Radio Silence: no GPS to the objective. Find it on your map.
admin.mission_blips.subtitle: Map blips for every part of a mission: the vans, evidence, cars, people, the hospital and your partners. Each part has its own switch, look and who sees it. Every change saves like a setting, is in the audit log and works at once.
admin.mission_blips.master_on: On: {n} of {total} parts show on the minimap and the big map
admin.mission_blips.master_off: Off: no extra blips show ({n} of {total} parts are ready to show when you turn it on)
admin.mission_blips.fair: Fair play is kept: a real player suspect's own position never shows (a live case shows only its last-reported points), nothing hidden shows before it is found, and Radio Silence still hides people and cars.
admin.mission_blips.empty: No mission blip settings were found. Check Config.MissionBlips in config/config.lua.
admin.mission_blips.parts_hint: Switch a part on, pick its look and, if you want, who sees it. A part without rules shows to every officer on the run.
admin.mission_blips.look.label: Name on the map
admin.mission_blips.hint.prisonerVan: The prisoner van coming to you. Shows only while Map markers' serviceVehicles is off.
admin.mission_blips.hint.prisonerDrop: Where the prisoner van waits for the hand-over
admin.mission_blips.hint.towTruck: The tow truck coming to you. Shows only while Map markers' serviceVehicles is off.
admin.mission_blips.hint.impoundDrop: Where the tow truck waits to load the car
admin.mission_blips.hint.coronerVan: The coroner van (morgue) coming to the scene
admin.mission_blips.hint.coronerDrop: Where the coroner van waits for the body bags
admin.mission_blips.hint.suspectVehicle: A suspect's car or a stopped car
admin.mission_blips.hint.parkedCar: The parked cars of a scene
admin.mission_blips.hint.witness: Witnesses and people to talk to
admin.mission_blips.hint.hidingSpot: Where a fugitive hid, once he was found
admin.mission_blips.hint.ambush: Ambush cars and attackers, once they appear
admin.mission_blips.hint.hospitalDrop: The nearest hospital while a live-case suspect is down
admin.mission_blips.hint.partner: The other officers of your run
admin.mission_blips.hint.reportedPoint: A live case's reported scene and last-reported points
